description: This file is a test suite for the Google-related payload processing and extra parameter handling in the AI integration project. It contains unit tests written with Vitest for functions that prepare payloads and options based on configuration and model parameters.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for Google thinking payload compatibility.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that a value meets expectations during testing.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for specific behaviors.

methods.name: runExtraParamsCase
methods.description: Executes a test case with given configuration and returns processed payloads/options.
